tests: Renders native button with visible accessible name.
Covers variant, intent, density inheritance, fullWidth, icon, disabled, and loading attributes.
Activates with pointer, Enter, and Space.
Disabled and loading block duplicate activation.
Focus visible works in normal and forced-colors modes.
Reduced motion removes loading spin and movement while preserving state information.
No raw values leak into component implementation.
Danger and warning preserve contrast across default, hover, pressed, disabled, and loading states.
Every foundation in artifacts.components.button.foundations has status covered plus decision, tokens, behavior, example, test, and rejectIf.
Context density strategy maps smartphones/phablets, tablets/laptops, and desktops/TV to density, layout, and rules.
Button exposes no public size prop; scale is inherited from Density.
Button supports sm, md, and lg density contexts without adding public size overrides.
Button icons inherit current label color across default, danger, warning, disabled, and loading states.
Secondary and outlined have distinct background, border, and surface adaptation behavior.
Secondary Button uses white background and neutral 900 outline/text.
Outlined Button uses white background and neutral 200 outline.
